zh-CN.title: 广场分享和图片布局
items: 广场会复用已加载的音乐信息和一滴分享摘要，来回切换时更快显示。
广场发言的多栏图片采用与单图相同的单张宽度上限。

en.title: Square shares and photo layouts
items: Square reuses music details and Drop share previews when you switch views.
Photos in two- and three-column grids use the same per-photo width limit as a single photo.
